summary: Iter-3 wide validation of Wayfare follow-up features (live Groq/Serper keys, Wikipedia city hero, shadcn DateRangePicker). ALL requested acceptance criteria pass. Backend: 12/12 pytest (4 new + 8 existing). /api/health reports groq:true & serper:true. /api/city-photo?city=Kyoto&country=Japan returns upload.wikimedia.org URL in <200ms (well under 5s). /api/plan streams SSE — first chunk arrives <1s, >200 chars collected almost immediately, real Kyoto itinerary content confirmed via curl. Frontend: /hotels — hotel-date-range button visible with 'MMM d → MMM d, yyyy' label; clicking opens popover with date-range-calendar showing TWO months (2 [role=grid]) side-by-side; picking day-5 & day-9 produced 9-night range with 16 emerald-bg cells (range highlight); label updated to 'Jul 25 → Aug 3, 2026' and nights badge '9N' present; native <input type='date'> COUNT=0 on /hotels; hotel-guests/rooms/tier/search-btn all present; date-range-clear exists inside popover. /sightseeing — typing 'Kyoto' + Explore renders [data-testid='city-hero-kyoto'] with city-hero-image whose src is upload.wikimedia.org (Kinkaku-ji, naturalWidth=3840) after ~4s. /planner — entering 'Kyoto' + Generate renders same city-hero-kyoto above streaming markdown itinerary (>4400 chars streamed, real content with Day 1 – Traditional Kyoto, Kiyomizu-dera, Gion, etc.). Regressions: all 8 routes (/, /planner, /budget, /sightseeing, /hotels, /flights, /restaurants, /visa) render Instrument Serif H1 with 0 pageerrors; ⌘K opens CommandPalette; theme-toggle present and clickable.
critical_code_review_comments: PlanInput schema uses `city` (not `destination`) — frontend must send `city`. Confirmed frontend does this correctly (streaming works end-to-end).

DateRangePicker default value is preset to today→tomorrow, so the trigger label is never empty. This is UX-friendly but tests that expect an empty initial label should assert the current preset instead.
CookieConsent banner overlaps the bottom of tool pages until Accept is clicked (expected per main agent). Tests handled this by dismissing when needed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all iter-3 acceptance criteria met, 0 pageerrors across 8 routes)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-3 is a full pass. Evidence: /api/health services={groq:true,serper:true,exa:false,rapidapi:false}. /api/city-photo returns https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6b/Kyoto%2C_Japan_%2849667780482%29.jpg/3840px-... in ~130ms. /api/plan SSE streams 'data: {"content": ...}' chunks for Kyoto 3d itinerary starting with '## Day 1 – Northern Kyoto Delights'. On /hotels: 0 native date inputs, DateRangePicker two-month popover renders 38 selectable day buttons and applies emerald bg to range cells, nights badge updates live (e.g. '9N'). On /sightseeing + /planner: [data-testid='city-hero-kyoto'] + [data-testid='city-hero-image'] uses upload.wikimedia.org src (naturalWidth=3840). Planner Generate streams >4400 chars of real markdown in ~15s. All 8 tool routes render H1 with 0 pageerrors; ⌘K opens palette. Nothing to fix — the follow-up is complete.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failures. Note for future testing: DateRangePicker default value is pre-populated (today→tomorrow), so 'initial empty label' assertions will fail; use 'Jul 25 → Jul 26, 2026' style pattern instead. Also PlanInput.city (not .destination) is the required field name.
